title: pvHistogram
body:
## pvHistogram

Bins one component (or the magnitude) of one array into equal-width bins and outputs a table with bin_extents (bin centre positions) and bin_values (counts), plus per-bin averages of the other arrays when CalculateAverages is on. Use it to study a value distribution, e.g. of pressure or velocity magnitude over a mesh. Counts are per point or per cell, not weighted by cell size. Use pvHistogram2D for the joint distribution of two variables.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- On a non-uniform mesh, unweighted counts do not represent volume or area fractions.
- With custom bin ranges, values outside the range are clamped into the first or last bin, not discarded.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Histogram`. Identity: `filters/ExtractHistogram`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Histogram filter. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject). The input needs at least one point- or cell-centred array. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BinCount` | The value of this property specifies the number of bins for the histogram. | `{"maximum":256,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `CalculateAverages` | This option controls whether the algorithm calculates averages of variables other than the primary variable that fall into each bin. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `CenterBinsAroundMinAndMax` | When set to true, first and last bin will be centered around the minimum and the maximum values of the data. By default, set to false. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Component` | The value of this property specifies the array component from which the histogram should be computed. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `CustomBinRanges` | Set custom bin ranges to use. These are used only when UseCustomBinRanges is set to true. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1]` |
| `Normalize` | Controls whether the values in the output are normalized, i.e., the count in each bin is divided by the sum of counts in each bin. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `SelectInputArray` | This property indicates the name of the array from which to compute the histogram. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `UseCustomBinRanges` | When set to true, CustomBinRanges will be used instead of using the full range for the selected array. By default, set to false. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
